source_index_lines: - [[eac-ascend-acoustics-sierra-1-v2]] — Erin's Audio Corner Klippel review, 2023-11-24 (Tier A)
brand_notes: Sierra-1 V2: bamboo laminated cabinet, 5.25 in woofer, SEAS Titan-based dome; maker previewed data to Erin; maker sample for Erin, member-loaned sample for ASR. Pairs matched to ±1.5 dB with serialized production-line plot.
takeaways: Two Tier-A Klippel measurements agree: LW ±1.6/1.7 dB, f3 52 Hz, very smooth early reflections, ERDI small.
Sensitivity only 81 dB (maker anechoic claim 83, in-room 87); output limited: 96 dB near 0.7 dB compression, 102 dB reaches ~3 dB near 150 Hz.
Impedance min 7 Ω (easy) but EPDR min 3.5 Ω above 80 Hz.
Erin and Amir both praise in-room neutrality; Amir finds it better with light EQ.
No user reports or independent pro-magazine reviews found.
log_bullets: Conflict: preference score 6.38 (EAC) vs 5.80 (ASR); sensitivity vs maker claim
